verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly claim a unified place to 'manage your local models, prompts, and configurations' (lm-studio-docs-6), backed by concrete features: model search/download (lm-studio-docs-4, 11), per-model load config via CLI flags like --gpu/--context-length/--identifier (lm-studio-docs-13,14), chat folders for organizing saved conversations (lm-studio-docs-27), and community corroboration of easy model management (lm-studio-comm-10, lm-studio-comm-4). Missing for 10: no dedicated 'saved prompts library' feature is explicitly documented (only chat folders/history), and some community reports note UI friction around model management (lm-studio-comm-1, lm-studio-comm-14).
